translationResources.title: Waterfall chart
translationResources.description: How a series of increases and decreases takes a value from a start to an end, with subtotals and totals: P&L bridges, cash flow, variances. Thin dashed connectors join every bar to the next one.

pnl.title: Profit and loss bridge
pnl.description: From revenue to net income: each change starts where the previous bar ended, subtotal and total bars show the running total from zero; the labels show the changes.

cash-flow.title: Cash flow
cash-flow.description: start sets the opening balance shown by the first subtotal, the months add their net flows and the closing balance ends the chart; yAxis.min zooms on the changes.

variance.title: Budget variance
variance.description: With orientation: "horizontal", the drivers explaining the gap between the budgeted and the actual margin are listed in rows.

headcount.title: Headcount bridge
headcount.description: upColor, downColor and totalColor replace the default colors, here arrivals in blue and departures in amber.

arr-bridge.title: ARR bridge by quarter
arr-bridge.description: Annual recurring revenue from the opening to the closing ARR of a quarter: new business, expansion, contraction and churn. A RadioGroup switches the quarter, start takes the previous closing ARR and yAxis.min zooms on the changes; the line below computes the net new ARR and the net revenue retention.

price-bridge.title: Price waterfall
price-bridge.description: From the list price to the pocket price of one unit, with the invoice price as a subtotal. onPointClick receives the clicked bar (event.items[0].index): the line below gives its amount as a share of the list price.

emissions.title: Emissions bridge
emissions.description: Emissions from the 2019 baseline to 2025: upColor and downColor are swapped so that increases are red and reductions green, a line annotation marks the 2030 target, and renderTooltip shows each change, where it starts and ends, and the gap to the target.

lead-time.title: Lead time breakdown
lead-time.description: Every stage of an order adds its duration and a total bar gives the lead time. Each step sets its own color (work or waiting), format writes days with the unit style of Intl.NumberFormat and connector draws solid lines.

live-balance.title: Live cash position
live-balance.description: The treasury balance during the day: a transaction arrives every two seconds (setInterval, cleared on pause and unmount), the oldest one leaves the window and is folded into start, so the first bar always shows the balance before the visible transactions.

options.title: Options
options.description: Sprint scope from the committed to the completed story points: try orientation, labels and connector.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: An income statement laid out in rows (orientation="horizontal"), which leaves room for the line names on a phone.

WaterfallChartProps.steps: Changes, subtotals and totals, in order
WaterfallChartProps.labels: Writes the change (or the total) at the end of every bar
WaterfallChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" lays the steps out in rows

WaterfallStep.label: Category name of the bar
WaterfallStep.value: Change (positive or negative); ignored by totals
WaterfallStep.kind: "subtotal" and "total" bars show the running total from zero
WaterfallStep.color: Color of this bar (any CSS color)

WaterfallOptions.name: Name of the series (tooltip)
WaterfallOptions.totalColor: Color of the totals and subtotals
WaterfallOptions.start: Value the first change starts from
WaterfallOptions.labels: Writes the change (or the total) at the end of every bar
WaterfallOptions.locale: Locale of the default series name; the page language by default
WaterfallOptions.connector: Thin lines from the end of every bar to the next one (dashed, secondary text color); false hides them, an object sets color, dash and width

ChartConnectorOptions.color: Line color (any CSS color); the secondary text color by default
ChartConnectorOptions.dash: Dash pattern in CSS pixels; [] draws solid lines (default [3, 3])

pnl.title: Profit and loss bridge
pnl.description: Changes float from the running total, the gross profit is a subtotal and the net income the total.

cash-flow.title: Cash flow from an opening balance
cash-flow.description: Monthly inflows and outflows in rows, from the opening balance to the closing total; values in the tooltip.

props.valueName: Name of the value in the tooltip
props.hideLabels: Hides the change (or total) written at the end of every bar
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected
props.hideConnectors: Hides the thin lines from the end of every bar to the next one

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
